info.title: Nexus E-Commerce Platform API
info.description: Complete REST API specification for the Nexus E-Commerce Platform. This specification is the v1.0 baseline — fully compliant with all 10 requirements in the SRS.

post.summary: Authenticate user and issue JWT session token
post.description: Validates user credentials (email and hashed password) and issues a signed JWT access token with configurable expiry. Returns a unique session_id for session management and audit trail purposes. Satisfies REQ-01: User Authentication and Session Management.

password.description: User password (transmitted over TLS; hashed server-side)

200.description: Authentication successful. Returns JWT access token, token expiry time, and a unique session_id for session tracking and revocation.

session_id.description: Unique session identifier for audit trail and session revocation

post.summary: Revoke authenticated session and invalidate JWT token
post.description: Invalidates the current JWT session token using the provided session_id. Ensures the session is removed from the active session registry, supporting secure logout and session audit trail integrity. Satisfies REQ-01.

session_id.description: The unique session identifier to revoke

200.description: Session successfully revoked. The JWT token is invalidated and the session_id is removed from the active session registry.

get.summary: Retrieve paginated product catalogue with filtering
get.description: Returns the full product catalogue with support for keyword search, category filtering, and price range filtering. Each product record includes product_id, name, description, category, price, stock_quantity, and image_url. Accepts pagination parameters (page and page_size) to control result volume. Satisfies REQ-02: Product Catalogue Retrieval.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Keyword-based text filter applied to product name and description

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Pagination: number of records per page

200.description: Paginated list of product records. Each record includes product_id, name, description, category, price, stock_quantity, and image_url.

get.summary: Retrieve a single product by ID
get.description: Returns the full product record for a specific product_id, including product_id, name, description, category, price, stock_quantity, and image_url. Satisfies REQ-02: Product Catalogue Retrieval.

parameters.name: product_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the product to retrieve

200.description: Full product record including product_id, name, description, category, price, stock_quantity, and image_url.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's persistent shopping cart state, including all cart items with their item_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, and the server-computed subtotal. Cart state persists across user sessions. Satisfies REQ-03: Shopping Cart Management.

200.description: Current cart state with all items (item_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price) and the computed subtotal.

post.description: Adds a product to the authenticated user's persistent shopping cart. Returns the updated cart state with the new item's item_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, and the updated subtotal. Satisfies REQ-03: Shopping Cart Management.

201.description: Item added. Returns updated cart state with item_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, and updated subtotal.

put.description: Updates the quantity of an existing item in the authenticated user's shopping cart. Returns the updated cart state with the revised quantity and recomputed subtotal. Satisfies REQ-03: Shopping Cart Management.

200.description: Updated cart state with revised item quantity and recomputed subtotal.

delete.description: Removes a specific item from the authenticated user's shopping cart. Returns the updated cart state with the item removed and the subtotal recomputed. Satisfies REQ-03: Shopping Cart Management.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: Unique cart item identifier to remove

200.description: Item removed. Returns updated cart state with the item removed and the subtotal recomputed.

post.summary: Process a refund transaction with idempotent transaction_id
post.description: Initiates a refund for a completed order. The client MUST provide a unique transaction_id in the request body to ensure idempotent processing — duplicate requests with the same transaction_id will return the original refund receipt rather than creating a duplicate refund. The transaction_id is included in the refund receipt response for end-to-end financial audit trail compliance. Satisfies REQ-04: Refund Transaction Integrity.

transaction_id.description: Unique client-provided identifier for idempotent processing and financial audit compliance. Must be unique per refund attempt.

refund_amount.description: Amount to refund in the order's currency

200.description: Refund processed successfully. Returns the refund receipt including the client-provided transaction_id, confirming end-to-end audit traceability.

transaction_id.description: Echo of the client-provided transaction_id for audit trail verification

post.description: Accepts a complete checkout payload including cart contents, shipping_address, delivery_method, and payment_method_token. Validates all fields and places the order, returning a unique order_id and estimated_delivery_date. Incomplete or invalid payloads are rejected with a structured validation error. High-value orders (total > $500) require prior 2FA verification (see REQ-09). Satisfies REQ-05: Checkout and Order Placement.

payment_method_token.description: Token representing the selected payment method

two_fa_token.description: 2FA verification token required for high-value orders (total > $500)

201.description: Order placed successfully. Returns order_id and estimated_delivery_date.

422.description: Structured validation error response for incomplete or invalid payloads.

get.summary: List all supported and saved payment methods for the user
get.description: Returns the authenticated user's available payment methods including credit/debit cards, digital wallet options (Apple Pay and Google Pay), and any saved payment instruments. Satisfies REQ-06: Payment Method Support.

200.description: List of payment methods available to the user, including card_token options, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and saved_payment_id references.

post.summary: Process payment using card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, or saved instrument
post.description: Processes a payment transaction. Supports multiple payment types declared via the payment_type field: 'card' (using card_token), 'apple_pay' (using apple_pay_token), 'google_pay' (using google_pay_token), and 'saved' (using saved_payment_id). The payment_type must be explicitly declared in the request. Satisfies REQ-06: Payment Method Support.

card_token.description: Card token — required when payment_type is 'card'

apple_pay_token.description: Apple Pay payment token — required when payment_type is 'apple_pay'

google_pay_token.description: Google Pay payment token — required when payment_type is 'google_pay'

saved_payment_id.description: Stored payment instrument ID — required when payment_type is 'saved'

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's real-time order fulfilment status for the specified order_id. The response includes a status_label and an array of timeline_events, each containing a stage name (order_placed, processing, dispatched, out_for_delivery, delivered) and an ISO 8601 timestamp. Returns 403 Forbidden for orders not belonging to the authenticated user. Satisfies REQ-07: Order Status Tracking.

200.description: Order status with status_label and timeline_events array. Each timeline event has a stage name and ISO 8601 timestamp.

403.description: Forbidden — order does not belong to the authenticated user.

get.summary: Retrieve full order fulfilment timeline with timestamps
get.description: Returns the complete chronological fulfilment timeline for the specified order, listing every stage transition with its ISO 8601 timestamp. Supports REQ-07: Order Status Tracking by providing detailed stage-by-stage delivery progress including order_placed, processing, dispatched, out_for_delivery, and delivered events.

200.description: Complete order timeline with all stage timestamps.

403.description: Forbidden — order does not belong to the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile including display_name, email, shipping_addresses array, and notification_preferences. Satisfies REQ-08: User Profile Management.

200.description: User profile with display_name, email, shipping_addresses, and notification_preferences.

put.description: Updates the authenticated user's profile fields including display_name, email, shipping_addresses, and notification_preferences. If email is changed, the response sets email_verification_pending to true, indicating a re-verification workflow has been triggered. Satisfies REQ-08: User Profile Management.

200.description: Profile updated. If email was changed, email_verification_pending is true.

email_verification_pending.description: True if email was changed and re-verification is required

post.summary: Issue a 2FA OTP challenge for high-value operations
post.description: Issues a time-limited One-Time Password (OTP) challenge for Two-Factor Authentication enforcement. Must be called before high-value operations: orders with total value exceeding $500 or first-time registration of a new payment method. The OTP is delivered to the user's registered device. Satisfies REQ-09: Two-Factor Authentication Enforcement.

operation_amount.description: Order amount in USD — required for high_value_order to validate threshold

200.description: 2FA challenge issued. Returns a challenge_token that must be submitted alongside the primary operation request.

post.summary: Verify 2FA OTP code and authorise high-value operation
post.description: Validates the user's submitted OTP code against the issued 2FA challenge. Upon successful verification, returns a two_fa_token authorising the pending high-value operation. This token must be submitted with the primary operation (e.g., checkout for orders > $500 or new payment method registration). Satisfies REQ-09: Two-Factor Authentication Enforcement.

challenge_token.description: The challenge token returned by the 2FA challenge endpoint

otp_code.description: The OTP code provided by the user

200.description: 2FA verified successfully. Returns two_fa_token authorising the high-value operation.

two_fa_token.description: Short-lived authorisation token to submit with the primary high-value operation

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's current notification subscription state for all categories: order_updates, promotional_offers, and security_alerts. Satisfies REQ-10: Notification Subscription Management.

200.description: Current notification preferences for order_updates, promotional_offers, and security_alerts categories.

put.description: Updates the authenticated user's notification preferences for any combination of categories: order_updates, promotional_offers, and security_alerts. Preference changes are persisted immediately and honoured by all downstream messaging services. The response confirms the updated preference state for each category. Satisfies REQ-10: Notification Subscription Management.

200.description: Preferences updated. Confirms updated subscription state for order_updates, promotional_offers, and security_alerts.
